test_observable_decorator: test the observable decorator that adds observer notification support to a class
test_ValueListObserver: test the ValueListObserver class that collects observed values into a list
test_add_observers: test the add_observers method to register multiple observers on an observable instance
test_add_observer_idempotent: test that add_observer is idempotent and does not duplicate observer registrations
test_no_observable_values_assertion: test that decorating a class with observable without values raises an AssertionError
